publication.title: iPhone OS Research Atlas
publication.scope: iPhone OS 1.1.4, build 4A102; original iPod reference and native PinePhone research
publication.provenance: Original editorial synthesis of private project notebooks and experiment reports, with reviewed capture images, selected source excerpts and their provenance. Firmware, storage images, complete run artifacts and the implementation repository are not included.

record.title: Idle residency does not measure charging
record.method: Matched pin-state control and timed PMIC/battery observations
record.observation: A defined inactive ANX7688 state yielded usable USB input. A 12-minute trial increased battery from 29% to 31%; a matched control also gained two percentage points.
record.limits: This validates the tested USB sink configuration, not full USB-C negotiation or all power sources. Recovery-time charging labels alone cannot identify charging during XNU.

records.access: Private project record; original material is not distributed

exhibits.title: Actual PMIC readbacks across the state control
exhibits.interpretation: These are register addresses and captured bytes, not a fabricated “charging” badge. In the long trial, register 0x00 later read 0xff at 600 s. Interpret the bytes within this USB sink experiment.

exhibits.title: Two bounded battery comparisons
exhibits.interpretation: Voltages are converted from the recorded microvolts. The readings bracket the native run in recovery; they are not a continuous charge-current trace or a universal USB-C negotiation result.
